description: This file defines the WebResponse class and related enums and nested classes for handling HTTP responses, including serialization and deserialization logic, within the Thunder::Web namespace.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with methods for serialization, deserialization, and managing response data.

classes.name: Response::Serializer
classes.description: Handles serialization of Response objects into a stream.

classes.name: Response::Deserializer
classes.description: Handles deserialization of stream data into Response objects.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Serializes a Response object into a string.

methods.name: FromString
methods.description: Deserializes a string into a Response object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the Response object has a valid error code.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the Response object to default state.
